    BACKGROUND

    Committeewoman Amalia Duarte is a 27-year township resident with a long history of community service. She volunteered with youth soccer and basketball programs as a coach and Board member. She was appointed to the township Recreation Commission in 2005 and served continuously for 12 years. She also served on the Board of Adjustment (Zoning) and Open Space Committee. During her nine-year tenure on the Township Committee, Committeewoman Duarte has served as liaison to nearly every sub-committee and volunteer group, including the Environmental Commission; Planning Board; Fire Department; First Aid Squad; Historic Preservation Committee; Mendham TV; Parks & Recreation Advisory Committee; Police Department; Shared Courts; and Surrounding Town Outreach. Professionally, she works as the Public Affairs Director for a nonprofit that provides services to children and adults with special needs. Her two adult children attended township public schools and graduated from West Morris Mendham High School. In her free time, Committeewoman Duarte enjoys playing softball, skiing, and spending time with family and friends.
